description: Checks one chat message with Paxmod, using the project's categories and thresholds. Returns flagged or not_flagged with a score per category. Counts as one of the project's messages, like a live request. Needs a Paxmod API key (create_test_api_key gives one).

api_key.description: Paxmod API key for the project.

context_id.description: Optional: the chat, channel or match it was sent in.

message.description: The message to check, up to 5000 characters.

user_id.description: Optional: the player who sent it.

name: moderate_text
title: Moderate a message
